claims_checked.claim: A noren is a split shop curtain used at many restaurants and some bathhouses.
Hanging/taking in the noren often signals open/closed for small shops.
claims_checked.note: Custom, not statute; lights and hours still matter.

claims_checked.claim: Every Japanese restaurant uses a noren.
claims_checked.note: Malls, chains, cafes often do not.

claims_checked.claim: Noren are uniquely Japanese and never existed elsewhere.
claims_checked.note: Article notes door curtains in other cultures; local form is distinctive.

claims_checked.claim: Noren-wake is a business metaphor for sharing a shop name/lineage.
claims_checked.note: Standard Japanese business vocabulary; not a visitor ritual.

caveats_about_absolutes: Note regional, generational, and situational variation
